evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible permission, behavior, constraint, state, or rule.
Inviting estimators by URL does not conflict with any other story; PP-028 adds a limit but PP-002 does not explicitly forbid one.
Starting a round by entering an item is compatible with item list management stories.
Viewing all session items does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.
Selecting an item for estimation or re-estimation is compatible with add, edit, and delete item stories.
Adding an item is consistent with other item management capabilities.
Editing an item is compatible with other item list operations.
Deleting an item does not conflict with other stories; deletion and re-estimation can coexist for non-deleted items.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This permits revealing estimates before all estimators have submitted, which conflicts with PP-033, which requires all estimates to be shown at the same time only after all estimators have given their estimate.
Accepting the average estimate is an alternative to manual entry and does not conflict with PP-012 or PP-011.
Auto-filling the estimate when all estimators agree supports acceptance and does not conflict with other estimation stories.
Manually entering the agreed-upon estimate is compatible with accepting an average or auto-filled value.
Re-estimating an earlier story is compatible with other item and estimation stories.
Importing stories from a spreadsheet is an alternative input method and does not conflict with other stories.
Copy/pasting stories from a spreadsheet is compatible with importing and manual entry.
Browsing previous games is compatible with game deletion and account stories.
Viewing a transcript does not impose rules inconsistent with other stories.
Exporting a transcript as HTML is compatible with other export and transcript stories.
Exporting a transcript as CSV is compatible with HTML export and other stories.
Deleting a game is compatible with browsing and exporting; it does not conflict with account deletion.
Account creation details do not conflict with login, update, or deletion stories.
Logging in with account name and password is compatible with account creation and management.
Changing account details is compatible with other account stories.
Deleting an account and its games is consistent with game deletion and does not conflict with account creation.
Showing local timezone is compatible with all other stories.
Password reminder conflicts with no other account or security story.
Selecting an estimation scale is compatible with card order and estimation stories.
The 15-estimator limit does not conflict with PP-002 because PP-002 does not explicitly require an unlimited number.
Joining a game with a name is compatible with moderator invitation and participant stories.
Seeing the current item is compatible with list and estimation stories.
Seeing all session items is compatible with other participant and moderator stories.
Seeing that an estimate has been given is about status, not the estimate value, and does not conflict with PP-033.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This requires estimates to be revealed only after all estimators have submitted, which conflicts with PP-009's permission to show estimates immediately even before all have given them.
Changing an estimate until the draw is completed is compatible with PP-033 and PP-041.
Viewing prior estimates does not conflict with current-round estimate reveal rules.
Seeing who gave which estimates during the round is compatible with simultaneous reveal after all estimates.
Starting a countdown timer does not conflict with other participant stories.
Timer reset after all estimates is compatible with estimation and timer stories.
Scrolling back through prior rounds is compatible with transcript and current-round stories.
Consistent card ordering is compatible with scale selection and estimation stories.
Changing an estimate until draw completion is consistent with PP-034 and PP-033.
Thumbnail photos during play do not conflict with research non-identifiability requirements.
Standards compliance does not explicitly impose a rule incompatible with browser support or accessibility stories.
A definitions list does not conflict with any other story.
Database indexes are a technical requirement that does not conflict with functional stories.
Legacy browser support does not directly conflict with standards or accessibility requirements.
Accessibility guideline compliance is compatible with other quality and functional stories.
Responsiveness does not conflict with other stories.
Unicode support is compatible with browser, standards, and content stories.
Predictable URLs do not conflict with any other story.
Nice error pages are compatible with all other stories.
Non-identifiable research results do not explicitly conflict with deletion, transcript, or identity-display stories.
Usage metrics do not impose rules inconsistent with other stories.
